source_note: Primary sources are official Orange County Notices of Commencement and other public records. News articles are secondary references only.

permits.title: Magic Kingdom – Tomorrowland Terrace (Buena Vista Construction / Facilities Asset Management)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed September 21, 2026, by Facilities Asset Management (FAM) with contractor Buena Vista Construction Company for “General Construction” at 1355 Monorail Way (Tomorrowland Terrace). Expires September 17, 2027. FAM/BVCC filings typically indicate maintenance or general construction rather than major themed or creative work. No specific project announced. Official Orange County document available. Source: WDWNT.
permits.location: Magic Kingdom – Tomorrowland Terrace (1355 Monorail Way)

permits.title: Magic Kingdom – McKim’s Mile House (Buena Vista Construction / Sourcing & Procurement)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed September 21, 2026, by Disney’s Sourcing & Procurement team with contractor Buena Vista Construction Company to “Provide labor, materials and/or electrical for construction” at McKim’s Mile House (DVC Member lounge in Frontierland, former Shootin’ Arcade). Expires one year from filing. Sourcing/BVCC filings typically indicate maintenance rather than major themed work. No specific project announced. Official Orange County document available. Source: WDWNT.
permits.location: Magic Kingdom – McKim’s Mile House / Frontierland

permits.title: Magic Kingdom – Adventureland (MLC Theming / Facilities Asset Management)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed September 21, 2026, for Facilities Asset Management (FAM) with contractor MLC Theming, Inc. for “General Construction” at 4851 Caribbean Way (Adventureland Popcorn Cart area, between Jungle Cruise and The Magic Carpets of Aladdin). Expiration August 31, 2028 (nearly two years, longer than typical one-year permits), suggesting potentially more substantial scope. MLC specializes in scenic painting, aging, facades, and rock work. FAM filings typically indicate maintenance/refurbishment rather than new attractions. No specific project announced. Corroborated by WDWNT and WDWMAGIC reporting.

permits.title: Hollywood Studios – Glob Theater / Monstropolis (Sign Producers / Walt Disney Imagineering)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed for Sign Producers Inc. to “Install signage” at 365 Cypress Dr. (former MuppetVision 3D theater, now the Glob Theater in the upcoming Monstropolis land at Disney’s Hollywood Studios). Filed by Walt Disney Imagineering; expires one year from filing. Scaffolding was largely removed in August with mounting points visible for a new marquee; concept art shows eye-inspired decorations on the marquee and clock tower plus a banner. The Glob will host Welcome to Monstropolis! With Sulley & Mike. Corroborated by WDWNT and WDWMAGIC reporting.
permits.location: Disney’s Hollywood Studios – Glob Theater / Monstropolis (365 Cypress Dr)

permits.title: Polynesian Resort – Island Tower (Faden Builders / Walt Disney Imagineering)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed September 18, 2026, by Walt Disney Imagineering for Faden Builders Inc. to provide “general construction” at 4601 Floridian Way, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830 (Island Tower at Disney’s Polynesian Villas & Bungalows). Permit expires one year from filing. WDI filing (rather than FAM or BVCC) typically indicates guest-facing or creative work rather than routine maintenance. Disney has not announced any specific project. Official Orange County document available. Corroborated by WDWNT and WDWMAGIC reporting.
permits.location: Disney’s Polynesian Villas & Bungalows – Island Tower (4601 Floridian Way)

permits.title: Magic Kingdom – Enchanted Tiki Room (Buena Vista Construction)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed for Buena Vista Construction Company to provide labor, material and/or electrical for construction at the Enchanted Tiki Room. BVCC (in-house) filing typically indicates maintenance rather than creative/show changes. No end date listed, defaults to one-year. Corroborated by WDWMAGIC reporting.

permits.title: Animal Kingdom – Former DINOSAUR / Indiana Jones site (Buena Vista Construction)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed the afternoon of September 11, 2026, for Buena Vista Construction Company to “provide labor, material and/or electrical for construction” at 501 Restaurantosaurus Road (former DINOSAUR attraction, now the site of the upcoming Indiana Jones & The Myth of the Jade Serpent ride in Tropical Americas). Filed by Walt Disney World Resort (not specifically Imagineering), indicating general construction work. Standard scope language; follows earlier construction and theming permit extensions in July. Facade installation of Mayan temple elements is ongoing. Corroborated by WDWMAGIC reporting.
permits.location: Disney’s Animal Kingdom – Tropical Americas / former DINOSAUR (501 Restaurantosaurus Road)

permits.title: Polynesian Resort – Tangaroa Terrace (New Horizon Construction)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed September 10, 2026, for Facility Asset Management with contractor New Horizon Construction Services for general conditions at 1540 Seven Seas Dr (Tangaroa Terrace). Expiration December 31, 2027. Companion filing to the September 8 KHS&S NOC for the same location. New Horizon has previously worked on Coronado Springs and Beach Club refurbishments. Tangaroa Terrace currently functions as a Cast Member break area; longer-than-usual expiration may indicate more extensive improvements. Corroborated by WDWNT reporting.
permits.location: Disney’s Polynesian Village Resort – Tangaroa Terrace (1540 Seven Seas Dr)

permits.title: Polynesian Resort – Tangaroa Terrace (KHS&S)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed September 8, 2026, for Facility Asset Management (FAM) with contractor Keenan Hopkins Schmidt & Stowell (KHS&S) for “general conditions” at 1540 Seven Seas Dr (Tangaroa Terrace). Expiration set for December 31, 2027 (longer than standard one-year), suggesting potentially more substantial work than routine maintenance. Tangaroa Terrace is a standalone building outside the Great Ceremonial House; previously a buffet restaurant and Neverland Club, currently used as a Cast Member break area. No confirmation of return to guest use. Corroborated by WDWMAGIC and WDWNT reporting.
permits.location: Disney’s Polynesian Village Resort – Tangaroa Terrace (1540 Seven Seas Dr)
